originalTitle: Pinterest Stock Halved In A Rising Market, So How Low Could A Crash Take It?
summary: Pinterest (PINS) stock fell 9.2% in its latest session, on September 9, 2026, to about $18.28. Over the past twelve months it lost 51.8% while the S&P 500 returned 18.5%, so that twelve-month decline was not market-wide. The company's last report paired a strong quarter with a slower outlook.
content:
Pinterest (PINS) stock fell 9.2% in its latest session , on September 9, 2026, to about $18.28. Over the past twelve months it lost 51.8% while the S&P 500 returned 18.5%, so that twelve-month decline was not market-wide. The company’s last report paired a strong quarter with a slower outlook.

Why Did Pinterest Guide Growth Lower After An 18% Quarter?

Pinterest sells advertising to brands and retailers chasing users who, by management’s account, mostly come to shop. In the quarter ended June 30, 2026, revenue grew 18%, and growth in UCAN, its U.S. and Canada market, also accelerated to 18%.

The outlook was the weak part. Pinterest guided Q3 2026 revenue growth to 13% to 15%, and management puts about three points of that step down on currency, an annual event’s spending shifting into Q2 2026, and a one-off World Cup boost. With those three points added back, management says the top of that range is consistent with the 18% quarter.

The other pressures it named are abroad, where Pinterest is rebuilding its go-to-market organization under new leadership and expects some disruption to continue in Q3 2026. Pressure from cross-border retailers hit by regulatory actions, particularly in Europe, arose midway through Q2 2026, and management says it has carried into Q3 2026.

Is Pinterest Growing Or Earning Less Than Before?

Over a full year, no. Trailing twelve-month revenue of $4.56 billion is up 16.6%, exactly its three-year average growth rate. Operating margin over the same window is 6.3%, about double its three-year average of 3.1%, though under the three-year peak of 7.6%.

Management also raised its full year 2026 adjusted EBITDA margin outlook to approximately 30%, from approximately 29%. The question is whether a soft patch abroad becomes the new pace.

How Far Could Pinterest Fall In A Real Shock?

In the six major market shocks since Pinterest first traded in 2019, its stock fell an average of 34% peak to trough , against an average of 17% for the S&P 500. Its deepest fall in any of those shocks was 54%, in the 2020 COVID-19 Crash. On a 10% position, that fall would have cut about 5% from the whole portfolio, and about 11% at a 20% weight.

Even 54% is not the floor. Its full price history holds a deeper fall, about 83% from a 2021 peak to a 2026 low.

Of the shocks it has fully recovered from, Pinterest took a median of about three months to climb from its low back to the prior high, though after the 2022 Inflation Shock & Fed Tightening it took about 18 months. It has not recovered from the two most recent. It fell 33% during the 2024 Yen Carry Trade Unwind, but still sits about 57% below its high before that shock and about 54% below its high before the 2025 US Tariff Shock.

So can you ride this out? Pinterest still falls about twice as hard as the market on average, but the typical three-month recovery no longer holds. On that history, riding it out means being able to wait years.

How Far Could Your Biggest Holding Fall?

The piece above put a number on how far this stock could fall, and a number like that matters most to whoever holds too much of one name. chineseTitle: Pinterest 股票在上涨的市场中减半，那么崩盘能将其跌至多低？
chineseSummary: Pinterest (PINS) 股票在 2026 年 9 月 9 日的最新交易中下跌 9.2%，至约 18.28 美元。在过去 12 个月里，该指数下跌了 51.8%，而标准普尔 500 指数则上涨了 18.5%，因此这 12 个月的下跌并不是整个市场的情况。该公司的上一份报告将强劲的季度与放缓的前景结合在一起。
chineseContent:
Pinterest (PINS) 股票在 2026 年 9 月 9 日的最新交易中下跌 9.2%，至约 18.28 美元。在过去 12 个月里，该指数下跌了 51.8%，而标准普尔 500 指数则上涨了 18.5%，因此这 12 个月的下跌并不是整个市场的情况。该公司的上一份报告将强劲的季度与放缓的前景结合在一起。

为什么 Pinterest 的指导增长率在季度增长 18% 后下降？

Pinterest 向品牌和零售商出售广告，以追逐用户，根据管理层的说法，这些用户大多是来购物的。截至2026年6月30日的季度，收入增长18%，其美国和加拿大市场UCAN的增长也加速至18%。

前景是薄弱的部分。 Pinterest 预计 2026 年第三季度的收入增长将达到 13% 至 15%，管理层将其中大约三个百分点的降幅放在了货币、年度赛事支出转移到 2026 年第二季度以及世界杯的一次性提振上。管理层表示，将这三点加回来后，该范围的上限与 18% 的季度一致。

它提到的其他压力来自国外，Pinterest 正在新领导层的领导下重建其进入市场组织，预计 2026 年第三季度将继续出现一些混乱。受到监管行动（尤其是欧洲）打击的跨境零售商的压力在 2026 年第二季度中期出现，管理层表示这种压力已延续到 2026 年第三季度。

Pinterest 是在增长还是收入比以前少了？

整整一年多了，没有。过去 12 个月的收入为 45.6 亿美元，增长了 16.6%，这正是其三年平均增长率。同一时期的营业利润率为 6.3%，约为三年平均水平 3.1% 的两倍，但低于 7.6% 的三年峰值。

管理层还将 2026 年全年调整后 EBITDA 利润率预期从约 29% 上调至约 30%。问题是国外的疲软是否会成为新的步伐。

Pinterest 会在真正的冲击中下跌到什么程度？

自 Pinterest 于 2019 年首次交易以来，在六次重大市场冲击中，其股价从高峰到低谷平均下跌 34%，而标准普尔 500 指数平均下跌 17%。其中最严重的跌幅是在 2020 年 COVID-19 崩盘中，下跌了 54%。如果仓位为 10%，那么整个投资组合的下跌将导致约 5% 的损失；如果仓位为 20%，则整个投资组合的损失将减少约 11%。

连54%都不是底线。其完整价格历史记录显示，从 2021 年的峰值跌至 2026 年的低点，跌幅约为 83%。

在完全从冲击中恢复过来的过程中，Pinterest 平均花了大约三个月的时间从低点爬回之前的高点，尽管在 2022 年通胀冲击和美联储紧缩政策之后，它花了大约 18 个月的时间。最近两次的情况还没有恢复。在 2024 年日元套利交易平仓期间，该汇率下跌了 33%，但仍比该冲击之前的高点低约 57%，比 2025 年美国关税冲击之前的高点低约 54%。

那么你能摆脱这个困境吗？ Pinterest 的跌幅仍然是市场平均水平的两倍，但典型的三个月复苏不再成立。就这段历史而言，渡过难关意味着能够等待数年。
